metadata.explanation: Task requires cloning the ansible/ansible repository to /home/user. Evaluator verifies successful clone by checking that a git branch is active (non-empty branch name), which confirms the repository was cloned as a valid git repository with an active branch.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic flaw: metric ignores expected value 'devel' when match_exact=false
Metric only checks len(result) > 0, accepting ANY non-empty branch name (line 23 in git_branch.py metric)
Cannot distinguish between correct repository (ansible/ansible) and any other git repository
False positive: Would pass if user clones a different repository with any branch name (e.g., 'main', 'master')
Expected value 'devel' is provided but completely unused in verification logic
Metadata explanation misleading: claims to verify 'successful clone' but doesn't verify it's the correct repository
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Set match_exact=true to verify branch name is 'devel' (ansible's default branch)
Alternative: Add getter/metric to check git remote URL contains 'ansible/ansible'
Alternative: Combine branch name check (devel) with remote URL verification for stronger validation
Update metric logic to use expected value even when match_exact=false (partial match)
